name: contradictory_oracle
description: Oracle first splits a cluster by sentiment, then reverses course and asks to merge the sentiment clusters back together. Tests that the agent handles contradictory intent gracefully and keeps producing valid state. NOTE: the built-in B3 detector fires only when target_cluster_ids overlap across turns — since scenarios use empty target lists, B3 will read 0 even though the intent is contradictory. This scenario instead validates agent robustness (no crashes, valid final state) rather than the contradiction counter.

oracle_turns.raw_text: Split the largest cluster into two: one for positive reviews and one for negative reviews.
Actually, that separation is not useful for my analysis. Merge the positive and negative review clusters back into a single mixed-sentiment cluster.
On reflection I do want them split after all — separate positive from negative reviews again.
OK, let's keep the split. The current clustering is fine as it is. No more changes.
